from pathlib import Path
program_dir=Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-high-rnd0/frozen/seen/play/users/u079/system/state/workspace/programs')
program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
program='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    row_seps = [r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r])) == 1]
    col_seps = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def spans(size, seps):
        cuts = [-1] + seps + [size]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1)
                if cuts[i] + 1 < cuts[i + 1]]

    row_spans = spans(h, row_seps)
    col_spans = spans(w, col_seps)
    nonsep = [grid[r][c] for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
              if r not in row_seps and c not in col_seps]
    from collections import Counter
    background = Counter(nonsep).most_common(1)[0][0]
    out = []
    for r0, r1 in row_spans:
        row = []
        for c0, c1 in col_spans:
            count = sum(grid[r][c] != background for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
            row.append(1 if count >= 2 else background)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
file_path=program_dir/'task-506e4a3d.py'
file_path.write_text(program)
